answer: Each submission hangs on the trellis of a task receipt, and the raven is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Reaching the reef of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
